label: live-study
notes: The design is 4 strategies on stage large at 30 repetitions, 120 runs, in its own session.
full and manifest run again here, so every comparison stays within one session: E2B dispatch
latency and the client uplink vary between sessions.
precopy and manifest-push add a push phase before the stop. While the heartbeat keeps running,
the browser records the dirty set under work/, exports the full image (precopy) or work/
without node_modules (manifest-push) and sends it to POST /prepare. The runner creates the
target, unpacks and, for manifest-push, runs npm ci. The stop phase then sends only the dirty
set plus state.json and process-snapshot.json and unpacks it over the prepared work/. No boot
and no install fall into the interruption. One push round only.
Data goes to data/live/, never into data/results.csv.
seed rule, the same as in main-study.json and fixed before the search: the first seed from
20261019 upward whose 4-cell dry-run plan has every cell at every position at least once.
Tried 20261019 (0 cells miss a position), the only seed tried.
Primary comparison, fixed before the runs: interruption_ms, median difference precopy against
full and manifest-push against manifest within this session, bootstrap CI and permutation test
as in the main study, under the restricted randomization of the seed rule.
Idle reference of push_source_ticks: the idle tick rate of this session, from the regression of
state_loss_ticks on stop_offset_actual_ms over all 120 rows. Rows with stop_offset_actual_ms
outside [0, logIntervalMs) are named by run_id, not dropped.
Before the full run: --repeats 1 as an acceptance check against E2B, with DATA_DIR, CSV_PATH
and ENV_PATH in a scratch directory, so data/live/ holds only the 120 runs.
